title: cross-lang: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics, parity fixes, version bumps to v1.200.0
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: bring the Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs into parity for auth handling, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics; prepare coordinated version bumps to v1.200.0. This reduces cross-language surprises for customers and enables consistent behavior for hosted/dedicated/private deployments.

What this PR does:
- Unifies auth flow to prefer credential providers with explicit fallback chain (env -> config file -> in-memory token provider).
- Standardizes retry policy semantics: idempotency detection, exponential backoff defaults, and per-call override API across all SDKs.
- Stabilizes streaming APIs: consistent half-close/finish semantics, cancellation propagation, and helper iterators/async iterables.
- Parity fixes for edge cases discovered in e2e tests (stream reconnect, large payload auth refresh race).
- Version bumps: python, typescript, go SDKs -> v1.200.0 and updates CHANGELOGs.

Checklist:
- [x] Update SDK surfaces and tests for auth/retries parity
- [x] Add streaming ergonomics helpers and docs examples
- [x] Run cross-lang integration matrix on CI (linux/mac/win)
- [x] Version bumps and changelog entries
- [x] Performance quick-checks to ensure no regression in sync/async paths

Notes: most changes are internal API compat wrappers; public surface changes are additive (new retry config object, small rename of streaming close() -> finish_stream()). Backwards compatibility is preserved for primary auth flows but a migration note is included for customers who relied on undocumented token refresh timing.
